protocol.caveat_memory_vs_model: these 500 pairs are held out from the MEMORY, not from the model: TASK 27 trained the predictor on all 7,666 val pairs, including these. Both arms share the predictor, so the delta is still a clean memory effect, but 'held-out' means 'never memorised' rather than 'never seen'.
protocol.state_note: eval queries are real queries: they increment region visits and hit counts, which feeds the adaptive-detail budget. ARM B never touches the memory, so the A/B delta is unaffected.
